import humanize

# Test R5: metric function behavior
print('Testing metric function:')
print(f'metric(1, \"Hz\") = {repr(humanize.metric(1, \"Hz\"))}')
print(f'metric(-1500, \"V\") = {repr(humanize.metric(-1500, \"V\"))}')
print(f'metric(3, \"W\", 5) = {repr(humanize.metric(3, \"W\", 5))}')
print(f'metric(1, \"°\") = {repr(humanize.metric(1, \"°\"))}')

# Verify expected values
assert humanize.metric(1, 'Hz') == '1.00 Hz', f'Expected \"1.00 Hz\", got {repr(humanize.metric(1, \"Hz\"))}'
assert humanize.metric(-1500, 'V') == '-1.50 kV', f'Expected \"-1.50 kV\", got {repr(humanize.metric(-1500, \"V\"))}'
assert humanize.metric(3, 'W', 5) == '3.0000 W', f'Expected \"3.0000 W\", got {repr(humanize.metric(3, \"W\", 5))}'
assert humanize.metric(1, '°') == '1.00°', f'Expected \"1.00°\", got {repr(humanize.metric(1, \"°\"))}'

print('R5 ✓ All metric tests passed!')
"
